array.string: cd /Users/sahajpatel/Code/ev && set -a && source .env 2>/dev/null; source "$HOME/.config/ev/opencode.env" 2>/dev/null; set +a; if [ -z "$OPENCODE_API_KEY" ]; then echo "[ev.opencode] OPENCODE_API_KEY is unset: launchd does not read ~/.zshrc. Put OPENCODE_API_KEY=... in /Users/sahajpatel/Code/ev/.env or ~/.config/ev/opencode.env, then: launchctl kickstart -k gui/$UID/ev.opencode" >&2; exit 78; fi; exec opencode serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 4096
